title: Employee Management
description: This is a back-end project for managing employee data and performance reviews. The system stores employee information in MongoDB and provides APIs to interact with it
challenges: Handling payment method and state management efficiently.
improvements: Improve UI/UX and add AI-based management suggestions.

title: Product Management
description: A web application to manage products efficiently with features like product listing, categories, inventory, and secure admin dashboard.
challenges: Implementing secure role-based authentication for admins and general users. and ensuring secure CRUD operations.
improvements: Add advanced analytics dashboard, integrate AI for product demand forecasting, Introduce real-time notifications for low stock alerts and system updates.

title: Language Exchange
description: A platform for users to find partners to practice different languages.
challenges: Matching users based on language preferences efficiently.
improvements: Implement AI-powered language matching and real-time chat.

title: Sport Store
description: An e-commerce platform for sports products with cart and checkout features.
challenges: Implementing real-time cart updates and handling payments.
improvements: Add product reviews and integrate payment gateways.
